dimensions.detail: The stated purpose, required ShotAI local library, ffmpeg rendering, optional LLM planning, and optional background music flow all fit the video remix workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill can activate for broad video-remix requests and probe mode may use video-library names, tags, summaries, or shot samples for planning; this is disclosed and tied to the purpose.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The installed package is instruction-only and non-executable, but it tells users to clone and run a separate GitHub Node project with npm dependencies, so the runtime must be trusted separately.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SHOTAI_URL and SHOTAI_TOKEN are proportionate for local MCP access, and LLM API keys or yt-dlp are optional; users should protect tokens and choose external providers intentionally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No artifact evidence shows hidden persistence, background autostart, privilege escalation, destructive actions, or undisclosed data exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[SDI-1] expected: The optional yt-dlp music path is disclosed in setup, README, CLI options, and safety notes; it expands network use but is purpose-aligned and avoidable with a local MP3.
[SDI-2] expected: External music retrieval is not required for local video remixing, but it is clearly framed as optional background music support rather than hidden behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The ShotAI MCP token is expected for the local ShotAI workflow; the artifacts disclose token use, though they should give stronger secret-handling guidance.
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger phrases match the skill's advertised video-remix purpose; they are worth user awareness but do not show purpose-mismatched access.
[SQP-2] expected: The YouTube download concern is a compliance and expectation issue more than a security defect; the artifacts disclose yt-dlp as optional but could add copyright and platform-terms warnings.
llm.guidance: Install only if you intend to use ShotAI for local video remixing. Review the separately cloned GitHub runtime before running npm install or npx, keep SHOTAI_TOKEN and any LLM keys out of logs and repos, use AGENT_PROVIDER=none or a local provider for sensitive footage, and use --bgm with a licensed local music file to avoid YouTube downloads.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed, documentation-only video remix skill with expected cautions around a separately cloned runtime, local media access, optional LLM use, and optional YouTube music downloads.
